description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different models, namely Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The Base model is represented by a black line with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 63% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to approximately 71% at 3*10^3. The FT model is depicted by a blue line with triangle markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 65% and rising to about 73% over the same range. The IKE model is shown as a red line with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 68% and increasing to around 75%. The MEND model is represented by a brown line with diamond markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 71% and rising to approximately 81%. The MEMIT model is illustrated by a purple line with triangle markers and a dashed line style, starting at about 70% and increasing to around 78%. The ROME model is depicted by a green line with square markers and a solid line style, beginning at approximately 75% and rising to around 87%. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
